snippet.title: I Built a Physics-First Pool Game! (No Ai)
snippet.description:
Wishlist *Bankshot!* on Steam

https://store.steampowered.com/app/5071700/Bankshot/

*Real Pool. Real Physics. Roguelike Progression.*

Bankshot! is my first commercial game and the project that's been occupying nearly every spare hour of my life for the past two years. 

It's a self-published billiards roguelike built around traditional 8-ball, real pool physics, and the idea that every shot should matter. 

If the game looks interesting, the single biggest thing you can do to help is wishlist it on Steam. 

 Every wishlist genuinely makes a difference for an independent developer.

Build with powerful items and charms, adapt to every table, and earn your place in The Hustle. 

Optionally I have included a "Purist" mode for those who just want to play pool. 

I have included several different rulesets that do not affect progression as optionals when starting a run and plan on adding more in the future as feedback comes in so I can implement the way *YOU* know the rules to be.

I didn't come from the games industry, and I don't have a known studio or publisher behind me. I started a studio in order to release this project while learning Godot and gradually built the game, the tools, and the workflow alongside it. Whenever I reached a point where existing tools couldn't do what I wanted or had too strict licensing outside of my affordibility, I instead chose to learn how to build my own so I could keep pushing the project toward the vision I had in mind.

Everything you see in `Bankshot!` was created by me. `Corvid Creative Studios`


All visual art was made by me. The music was composed by me in LMMS, using samples I created myself alongside CC0 samples and soundfonts.

Music is not my strongest skill however I understand how music should be composed and did my best in my DAW to create music that would be appealing. If the samples I used were falsely labeled as Non-Ai, that would be a failure of the sites offering these samples to not disclose this information, I would not be able to detect it with my ear unless it was blantantly obvious, so the current soundtrack is functional rather than polished I hope that you can for atleast the time being look past the current state of the music as I continue to work with dedicated musicians to bring it up to the standard the rest of the game deserves.

In the Post development stage of the project I still refused to use any sort of AI "help" yet platforms(Social media/YouTube) do not care or rather *want* you to use AI.

 I have since discovered that some of my sample sources may have been made using AI-assistance, flagged by YouTube, and therefore causing my weeks of hard work handmade DAW tracks to be flagged as ai, despite my efforts to verify them beforehand. Going forward I will be cycling these tracks out of the project using real musicians rather than relying on samples.

The pool physics simulation was written from scratch in C++ for Godot and continually compared against real-world physics until it felt authentic.

I visited Billard stores and Billard halls in order to photograph tables, studied equipment, and spoke with experienced players to make the environment feel grounded while still supporting the roguelike gameplay.

The visual direction is heavily inspired by the atmosphere of places I personally have visited and played pool in that always felt like they had not been renovated since some point roughly inbetween the 1960s to the 1990s. Rather than chasing flashy effects, I leaned into more of the minimalism aspect of visual representation, even if just for the Early Access Initial Release.

This teaser is only the beginning. I plan to try to release a new trailer for every major update that I have planned aswell as listen to community feedback in shaping the final aspect of the game. I prefer to not ask you to join the 10,000th discord server and recommend you to instead either reach out to my support email for feedback or post on the steam discussions until I get an oldschool forum up and running for the game's community.

Thank you for taking the time to watch and read.

 Wishlist on Steam
https://store.steampowered.com/app/5071700/Bankshot/

Planned Release: October 2026
